whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Choo Mantar,

I noticed your healing and wellness center has strong 4.5★ reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new client inquiries and session bookings.

Maine aapke wellness center ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, healing services menu, aur client testimonials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://choomantar.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Choo Mantar team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke wellness center ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp session booking and a showcase of your healing services right in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
